item.title: D-Link DIR-600L HNAP SOAPAction Pre-Auth Stack Buffer Overflow (CVE-2026-129354)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 10) — network · CVE-2026-129354 (VulDB 437417). Status: PoC. Affects: D-Link DIR-600L wireless router (hardware revision B1, shared DIR-600Bx platform image); HNAP handler hnap_main in htdocs/cgibin, reached as /usr/sbin/hnap through boa's /HNAP1/ mapping. Tags: dlink, dir-600l, router, hnap, soapaction, stack-buffer-overflow, cwe-121, pre-auth, qemu-user, iot.
